column3: どら焼き作りに専念していた満月製粉所。しかし、ある日から作業現場を逃げ出す月ウサギが増え、製粉所の経営が厳しくなってしまった。悲しみに暮れる作業班長の娘$npc:11004248$がメイプルワールドに降りてきて、冒険者たちのためのどら焼きを供給する方法を考えているそうだが…。⏎$npc:11001003$はメイプルワールドの各所に浮かぶ花風船を調べると出てくる$item:30001427$を加工すれば、満月製粉所のどら焼きに近い香りを出せると言う。これはダメ元でやってみるしかない！落ち込んでいる満月製粉所の月ウサギたちのために、$item:30001427$を10個集めて$map:02000064$にいる$npc:11004248$に届けよう。
column4: The Full Moon Flour Mill devoted itself entirely to making dorayaki. However, one day, the moon rabbits began escaping the workplace more and more often, and the mill's business took a turn for the worse. The heartbroken foreman's daughter, $npc:11004248$, has come down to Maple World and is apparently thinking of a way to supply dorayaki to adventurers...⏎$npc:11001003$ says that by processing the $item:30001427$ you get from checking the flower balloons floating around Maple World, you can produce an aroma close to that of the Full Moon Flour Mill's dorayaki. It is worth a shot! For the dejected moon rabbits of the Full Moon Flour Mill, gather 10 $item:30001427$ and deliver them to $npc:11004248$ at $map:02000064$.

Use $item:20301895$ to enter $map:80000016$, see what is happening there, and inform $npc:11004248$ at $map:02000064$.⏎You can obtain $item:20301895$ from the Special Sales tab in the Item Shop. $npc:11004248$はメイプルワールドの各地に現れる奇異な姿の巨大ウサギの話を聞いたと言い、彼らが満月製粉所を抜け出した仲間たちのようだと言った。母から聞いた月ウサギ部族の伝説によれば、遠い昔数匹の月ウサギたちが怪しいオーラに染まって製粉所を襲ったことがあり、彼らを制圧してオーラを浄化したらようやく正気を取り戻したとのことだった。彼らには申し訳ないが、この方法で仲間たちに安息を与えたいという$npc:11004248$。悲しむ彼女の代わりに$map:02000043$に現れる$npc:27000034$を制圧し、$npc:11004248$に結果を知らせよう。⏎⏎$npc:27000034$は毎時30分になると$map:02000043$に現れる。
column4: $npc:11004248$ said they had heard about the bizarre giant rabbits appearing across Maple World and thought they seemed to be comrades who escaped the Full Moon Mill. According to the legend of the moon rabbit tribe told to them by their mother, long ago several moon rabbits became stained with a strange aura, attacked the mill, and only after they were subdued and the aura purified did they finally regain their sanity. Feeling sorry for them, $npc:11004248$ wanted to give their comrades peace in this way. In the grieving witch's place, subdue $npc:27000034$ who appears in $map:02000043$ and inform $npc:11004248$ of the outcome.⏎⏎$npc:27000034$ appears in $map:02000043$ at the 30th minute of every hour.

column3: 추석을 맞아 월병을 만드느라 가장 바쁜 나날을 보내던 달토끼 방앗간. 어느 날 갑자기 작업 현장을 이탈하는 달토끼들이 늘어나 방앗간을 제대로 운영할 수 없게 되었고, 슬픔에 몸져누운 작업반장의 딸 $npc:11004248$$pp:는,은$ 메이플 월드에 내려와 모험가들을 위한 월병을 보급할 방법을 맹렬히 고민 중이라고 하는데…⏎$npc:11003139$$pp:는,은$ 메이플 월드 곳곳에 흩뿌려진 꽃 풍선을 조사했을 때 나오는 $item:30001201$$pp:를,을$ 다듬으면 달토끼 방앗간의 쑥 월병과 비슷한 향을 낼 수 있을 것 같다고 말한다. 밑져야 본전! 좌절하고 있는 달토끼 방앗간의 달토끼들을 위해, $item:30001201$$pp:를,을$ 10개 모아 $map:02000064$에 있는 $npc:11004248$에게 가져다 주자.
column4: The Moon Bunny Mill was spending its busiest days making mooncakes for Chuseok. One day, more and more moon bunnies suddenly left the worksite, making it impossible to run the mill properly. $npc:11004248$, the bedridden work supervisor's daughter, came down to Maple World and is fiercely thinking of a way to supply mooncakes for adventurers...⏎$npc:11003139$ says that if you refine $item:30001201$, which appears when investigating flower balloons scattered throughout Maple World, it may give off a scent similar to the Moon Bunny Mill's mugwort mooncakes. Nothing to lose! For the discouraged moon bunnies of the Moon Bunny Mill, collect 10 $item:30001201$ and bring them to $npc:11004248$ in $map:02000064$.

column3: $npc:11001002$$pp:는,은$ 갑자기 방앗간을 떠나 버린 달토끼들이 괴이한 기운에 물들어 메이플 월드 곳곳에 나타나고 있고, 그 괴이한 기운은 보름달 뒤의 비밀스러운 공간에서부터 나오고 있는 것 같다고 말한다. 과연 달토끼들의 변화와 그 수상한 공간은 무슨 관계가 있는 것일까? $item:20301895$$pp:를,을$ 사용해 $map:80000016$에 들어가, 그곳에서 벌어지는 일을 살펴보고 $map:02000064$에 있는 $npc:11004248$에게 알려주자.
column4: $npc:11001002$ says the moon bunnies who suddenly left the mill are appearing throughout Maple World, stained by a strange energy, and that this strange energy seems to be coming from a secret space behind the full moon. What connection is there between the moon bunnies' change and that suspicious space? Use $item:20301895$ to enter $map:80000016$, observe what is happening there, and tell $npc:11004248$ in $map:02000064$.

column3: $map:80000016$에 들어가 무슨 일이 벌어지고 있는지 살펴보기
column4: Enter $map:80000016$ and see what is happening

column3: $npc:11004248$$pp:는,은$ 메이플 월드 곳곳에 나타나는 괴이한 모습의 큰 토끼들에 대해 들었다며, 그들이 보름달 방앗간을 떠났던 동료들인 것 같다고 말한다. 어머니가 들려준 적이 있는 달토끼 부족의 전설에 의하면 먼 옛날 몇몇 달토끼들이 이상한 기운에 물들어 방앗간을 헤집어 놓은 적이 있고, 그들을 제압해 기운을 빼 놓고서야 일부 달토끼들이 정신을 차렸다는 것이다. 안타깝지만 그렇게라도 동료들에게 안식을 주고 싶다는 $npc:11004248$. 슬퍼하는 그녀 대신 $map:02000043$에 나타난다는 $npc:27000034$$pp:를,을$ 제압하고 $npc:11004248$에게 결과를 알려주자.⏎⏎$npc:27000034$$pp:는,은$ 오후 19:30, 20:30, 21:30, 22:30에 $map:02000043$에 나타난다.
column4: $npc:11004248$ says she heard about the strange large rabbits appearing throughout Maple World, and that they seem to be the companions who left the Full Moon Mill. According to a moon bunny tribe legend her mother once told her, long ago some moon bunnies were stained by a strange energy and wrecked the mill. Only after they were subdued and the energy was drained did some moon bunnies regain their senses. $npc:11004248$ is saddened, but wants to give her companions peace even if it must be done that way. In her place, suppress $npc:27000034$, which appears in $map:02000043$, and tell $npc:11004248$ the result.⏎⏎$npc:27000034$ appears in $map:02000043$ at 19:30, 20:30, 21:30, and 22:30.

column3: $map:02000001$, $map:02000100$, $map:02000076$, $map:02000023$, $map:02000062$, $map:02000064$ 중 한 곳에 애드벌룬을 설치해 메이플스토리2 1주년을 축하하는 메시지를 남겨보자.
column4: Install an advertising balloon in one of $map:02000001$, $map:02000100$, $map:02000076$, $map:02000023$, $map:02000062$, or $map:02000064$, and leave a message celebrating MapleStory 2's first anniversary.

column3: 유령들이 날뛰는 할로윈 기간을 맞아, 던전에 득실대는 악령의 기운에 지지 않는 용기를 보여달라고 말하는 $npc:11001002$.⏎$item:20301427$$pp:를,을$ 받으면 할로윈의 용사를 위한 선물을 준다고 하니, 던전을 클리어해 주간 보상 획득 횟수 30회를 채운 후 $item:20301427$$pp:를,을$ 받고 $npc:11001002$$pp:가,이$ 준비한 선물도 받아 보자.
column4: For the Halloween season when ghosts run wild, $npc:11001002$ asks you to show courage that will not lose to the evil spirit energy filling the dungeons.⏎They say they will give a gift for Halloween heroes if you receive $item:20301427$, so clear dungeons until you have earned weekly rewards 30 times, receive $item:20301427$, and get the gift prepared by $npc:11001002$.

column3: $npc:27000051$$pp:를,을$ 요리하면 보통의 칠면조와는 비교조차 할 수 없을 만큼 훌륭한 진미가 된다는 소문이 있다. $npc:11001002$$pp:는,은$ 추수감사절 기간에 손님들을 대접하기 위해 $npc:27000051$$pp:로,으로$ 만든 요리를 올리고 싶다고 한다. $npc:11001002$에게 열흘 동안 $npc:27000051$$pp:를,을$ 잡아서 가져다 주면 많은 손님들을 대접할 만큼 충분할 것 같다.
column4: Rumor says that if you cook $npc:27000051$, it becomes a delicacy so excellent it cannot even be compared to ordinary turkey. $npc:11001002$ wants to serve a dish made with $npc:27000051$ to entertain guests during Thanksgiving. If you catch and bring $npc:27000051$ to $npc:11001002$ for ten days, it should be enough to serve many guests.

column3: $npc:11001003$$pp:는,은$ 이벤트 기간 동안 열리는 특별한 던전에 대해 이야기해주며 이곳을 통해 빠르게 성장할 수 있다고 안내해준다.⏎한 주 동안 $dungeonTitle:29007001$, $dungeonTitle:29007002$$pp:를,을$ 30회 클리어하고 빠른 성장을 위한 아이템들을 받아 보자.⏎단, 두 던전의 일간/주간 보상 획득 횟수는 계정 단위로 공유된다.
column4: $npc:11001003$ tells you about a special dungeon open during the event and explains that you can level up quickly through it.⏎Clear $dungeonTitle:29007001$ and $dungeonTitle:29007002$ a combined 30 times in one week to receive items for rapid growth.⏎Note that the daily/weekly reward limit for both dungeons is shared at the account level.

column3: 시간의 균열로 인해 다른 차원의 공간으로 이동할 수 있는 문이 열렸다. 이게 다 $map:02000420$에서 비롯된 일이라는데…⏎균열이 오래 지속되면 어떤 위험한 일이 생길지 모른다. $dungeonTitle:29006001$$pp:로,으로$ 가, $npc:23000077$$pp:를,을$ 상대하자.
column4: A rift in time has opened a gateway to a dimension from another world. It all traces back to $map:02000420$...⏎If the rift persists for long, who knows what dangers may arise. Head to $dungeonTitle:29006001$ and face $npc:23000077$.

column3: 시간의 균열로 만든 다른 차원의 공간이 모험가들에게 인기만점이라고 한다. 이에 $npc:23000077$$pp:는,은$ 다른 차원의 공간을 추가로 만들려 한다는데…⏎균열이 오래 지속되고 더 커지면 어떤 위험한 일이 생길지 모른다. $dungeonTitle:29006001$$pp:로,으로$ 가, $npc:23000077$$pp:를,을$ 상대하자.
column4: The other-dimensional space created by the time rift has become wildly popular among adventurers. Now $npc:23000077$ plans to create even more dimensional spaces...⏎If the rift lasts too long and grows larger, unforeseen dangers may follow. Head to $dungeonTitle:29006001$ and face $npc:23000077$.

column3: 시간의 균열로 만든 다른 차원의 공간에 모험가들을 가둬 두는 게 $npc:23000077$의 속셈이라고 한다.⏎모험가들이 위험에 처하기 전에 $dungeonTitle:29006001$$pp:로,으로$ 가, $npc:23000077$$pp:를,을$ 상대하자.
column4: Apparently, $npc:23000077$'s true plan is to trap adventurers inside the other-dimensional space created by the time rift.⏎Before adventurers fall into danger, head to $dungeonTitle:29006001$ and face $npc:23000077$.

column4: $npc:11000157$ says that true romance means enjoying solitude and exploring yourself, and asks you to play a song with any sheet music.⏎Apparently, immersing yourself in a world where only music and you exist is the third training exercise... I have no idea what that means, but since it's the third one, I might as well keep going.⏎Play any sheet music, then find $npc:11000617$ in $map:02000118$.
